purpose: User-approved background assets awaiting integration into the production rotation; this catalog is not itself the active render catalog.
license_summary: Pexels states its uploaded photos/videos use the Pexels License and may be used free for personal and commercial purposes without attribution. Recheck the current license and clip page before downloading or enabling each asset.
activation_policy: The original four candidates passed download/ffprobe verification and received explicit user visual approval on 2026-11-01. Seven additional Pexels candidates received explicit user visual approval on 2026-11-08 after reviewing the Quran-overlay contact sheet; their review-workflow download/ffprobe checks passed. All eleven are approved for production integration, but none of the new seven is active until renderer integration and render/legibility tests pass.
